Intl disabled. Host development sysroot and declared ELF ABI remain external prerequisites; no Firefox browser, complete upstream suite, benchmark or Dataset qualification.

notes: 与Firefox浏览器整包区分功能范围；只验shell和明确JIT路径。
The target distribution records the validation host; the unchanged manager checks OS, architecture and actual ELF/runtime requirements, without a distribution-name gate.

Runtime ABI and host Python/ldd are checked at installation; exact imported toolchain input hashes and bundled subsets are separately recorded. Qualification flags and evidence delimit actual source-build/runtime capabilities; benchmark, OCI and other-platform qualification are not inferred.
